nom: COOLA Full Spectrum 360° Sun Silk Drops Organic Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.texte: I've also had an allergic reaction to this product the last 5 times I've used it. I went to the doctor because I thought I had eaten something that caused severe itchiness all over my face and neck, but she said it was from something I used on my face. I had used Coola Sun Silk drops for 5 months with no issues. Perhaps there's an ingredient that goes bad after a few months? Beware, this itchiness takes a few days to go away and has kept me up at night.

Did the formula change? I loved this product last year. It was a staple for me. This year my face now gets extremely itchy, red and now swollen from this product. I thought it was a coincidence or just a reaction from being in the sun, but I woke up with my eye swollen and half closed.

I wish I would have read the reviews on this product before I tried it 😞 I am suffering from the same red, hot, itchiness that others are reporting. I regularly use the classic face sunscreen and I have never had a problem.
I use this product over makeup as a dewy highlighter with a bonus of additional spf. Makes my 40 yr old skin look hydrated and luminous. I know it's not meant for that, but it's magic!

I have been on an spf journey for years. I can tell you with complete honesty that this one actually works and does not pill! Thats my main issue with the dozens and dozens of spf's i have purchased they always end up pilling. Im going to try the coola oil next . This does leave a little dewy look but not shiny and i repeat not pilling!

I have been on an spf journey for years. I can tell you with complete honesty that this one actually works and does not pill! Thats my main issue with the dozens and dozens of spf's i have purchased they always end up pilling. Im going to try the coola oil next . This does leave a little dewy look but not shiny and i repeat not pilling!
I've used this product for a few years and never had a reaction until now. My skin instantly started stinging and caused my eyes to swell, get red, itchy and now they are peeling. I do not recommend.

I've tried this as well as the facial spray and got the most horrible allergic reactions that lasted for days. I have normal skin thats not sensitive at all so it takes a lot for me to react the way i did to something. Staying far away from ALL Coola products
I LOVE IT- really is 'anti-aging' SMILING&HAPPY the lines round my eyes&mouth are gone, until they return LOVING COOLA **UNHAPPY rewards program discontinued.. COOLA'S

avis.titre: Made my face puffy, itchy and red.
avis.texte: I've bought this product in the past and loved it. This last bottle made my face puffy, itchy and red for days. I did a test patch on my neck last night and that area reacted the same way.

I will say this did make my skin look great and my makeup went on realky well over it (about an hour after application) but made my eyes burn about 30 minutes after application. I did have to wash the area around my eyes to remove it. However, I do have sensitive skin and eyes, my skin seems to be doing well with it, but need to keep clear from the entire eye area next time.

Cant really review this product due to recieving it half empty.. im not sure if it was used or if it is due to a manufacturing issue. The box was still sealed with tape. It didnt look tampered with. A bit bummed out. Hopefully I can exchange it for a new one.

I picked this up when my last SPF became unavailable and I could not be happier with my choice! It's light, my face doesn't start sweating profusely as soon as it's put on. Best part- I have sensitive skin and get weird dry red patches which other products have made worse- this seems to be making it clear up! Much more confident when I go out with SPF only on my face.

I love the lightness is this product and what it accomplishes. Other reviews says it smells nice so I purchased. I can't stand the smell. It reminds me of car wax smell and my dad's car paint shop. You can't smell it out of the bottle but as soon as I spread it on my face it's like all I can smell is car wax. Never had a cola product I didn't like. But for the cost of this I'm highly disappointed in this smell.
This sunscreen worked fine the first few times before it suddenly caused me to have an allergic reaction. Once I realized it was this product and discontinued used I had no issues.

Love the product, wish it didn't cause an allergic reaction. This product left my face extremely red, hot and itchy after repeated use. Beware if you have these symptoms and stop using immediately. Even tried again after symptoms cleared up. Definitely is due to the product.
After only one use this made me skin extremely inflamed. Hot and itchy for days after. i ended up needing medication to deal with the severe reaction
These are great! Used alone or mixed in my moisturizer they seem to work well. It's winter here so the real test will be in summer

After this past year of me using this dont get me wrong its lasted great and i loved how easy it was to apply on my dry skin but it did give me two new sun spots that i never had before, and i used this everyday and reapplied it when i was out in the sun all day.
I love this product! It goes on so smoothly, is not irritating to my sensitive skin and performs well under cc cream or great on it's own. It's a staple in my routine.
I bought this on sale because I needed a new sun protectant and I love it. It doesn't make my face feel greasy or mess with my foundation. It's also very easy to apply. I like the dropper.
I have tried many brands of SPF over the years. This is very light weight, does not sting your eyes and does not have white cast. It is perfect in every way!!

I love all of coola sunscreens and use everyday for years. My favorite is the sun silk drops. I introduced it to several of my co-workers and they absolutely love it this is one of the best products I've ever used. Thank you Coola you are awesome.

Similar to other reviewers, this product started out fine but after somewhat consistent use I realized this product was making my skin red, itchy, and hot to the touch. It may be the amount of avobenzone? Proceed with caution/avoid if you have sensitive skin or rosacea.
It caused a bad allergic reaction to my skin, causing it to become itchy, red, and inflammed.

avis.titre: You can't feel it, but it works
avis.texte: I've been using this for several years now and I use it daily. It prevents burn even in direct sunlight. It's long lasting, lightweight. Goes perfect under makeup. You cannot feel it after it dries, it's a lighter sunscreen smell too that goes away shortly after applying. I've found nothing like it and will continue to use always.

avis.titre: Sad to say goodbye...bad allergic reaction
avis.texte: I use to love this product but the last two bottles caused extreme allergic reactions where it looked like I had burns on my neck and was so itchy that I had to get an anti inch prescription. At first I thought it was a food or wine allergy so I kept using this product. I only noticed it after not using the product for a month and got the same reaction within an hour of using it again. I am so sad as I loved this product, even at the steep price. Not sure if it's me or if Coola change something.
Tried this one time and had a terrible reaction! I don't have sensitive skin, so think it was definitely the product.
I love the consistency and protection, but after application my face always feels hot and burning. I have dry skin so maybe thats why? Thankfully got this as a mini sample. Won't purchase.
Had severe reaction on my face using this. Also had same reaction when using the Dew Good Serum. I have never reacted like that to any other face product before.
Returned immediately. Left my skin looking weird under makeup. Very runny consistency. Disappointed. Really wanted to like it:(
I have never felt comfortable without any makeup and this is truly a work of art! I dont know why this isnt a more popular sunscreen! This is just absolutely beautiful on the skin.

avis.titre: Does not make your skin feel silky
avis.texte: I bought this for my granddaughter. It sounds great, ingredients look great. But it doesn't spread well, feel good on the skin or smell good. I told her Mom to return it and get something else with sunscreen. Disappointed
is lightweight, good moisturizer, your face is going to be a little shiny, but it absorbs decently, and have a very good protection. I use it at home and in the gym.

avis.titre: I am a regular customer of this product
avis.texte: I like the way it goes and feels under my makeup. It is towards moisturizing, if you have oily skin than it is not for you. I took off one star because it is bit pricey.
Love this sunscreen! I bought it for my mother this time. She's had never taken care of her skin. Now she is and wanted something lightweight. This is perfect! She's actually using it.
I have acne prone skin, so I'm very sensitive to products. This is one of the only sunscreens that has worked for my skin!
Best face cream ever ! Love the texture and feel on my skin !
I have lived every product from Coola. I was getting blisters on my lips at the beach, now i wear your tinted sunscreen for lips and I love it

avis.titre: Super happy to have found this !!
avis.texte: It's the perfect sunscreen and blue light protector for my face. Goes on like a serum. It disappears into your skin leaving it moisturized, protected but not super shiny, just a very slight glow. Love it ! Oh and best of all it does not break out my sensitive skin.

Absolutely loved this and all the Coola products I purchased. this sunscreen is a serum consistency, which makes it way more comfortable than a thick lotion sunscreen, and allows for better absorption, so you don't sweat or easily wipe it off. Also loved that there was no white cast, or stinging, which always happens on my sensitive skin. Will be purchasing every summer for sure.
I like that I can mix this sunscreen in with my skin cream or foundation. It is very liquidy which makes it easy to do. It has a nice texture and smell. I just wish it were 'œclean'.

They did not work for me as I was hoping to use them reapplication over makeup but the formula just breaks makeup down no matter how I apply it. In the right amount would be a great sunscreen option but I feel like you could go through quickly.

I absolutely love this sunscreen! Living in Florida, I apply it every morning before my moisturizer to keep my skin safe from UV exposure. It's a great benefit that blue light protection is included as well, as I am constantly on a computer for work. This bottle also goes a long way--you only need to apply a little, so it should last some time!

avis.titre: Lovely and Feels Light on Skin
avis.texte: I love this product. My only complaint is the cost. I like the smooth and light texture. Blue light protection and sunscreen in a lightweight formula is what makes this a favorite for me.

avis.titre: Full spectrum sun silk drops by Coola
avis.texte: I use this in the morning under my makeup or alone. It is super hydrating and not oily at all. It absorbs completely leaving my skin soft and protected from the sun.

I have super oily skin and hair. and I breakout if I even think of putting sunscreen on. This product was the first one I have ever used consistently (after doing several days worth of test patches) and had no breakouts! I also used it more consistently because I could mix it in my moisturizer (the ordinary) or liquid face make up (bare minerals). I started getting dark spots during my pregnancy 2 years ago and now they pop up quickly with any sun exposure. Thanks to consistent use my dark spots are even less noticeable. Very happy with this product, I just hate the price. I have used it 5-7 days a week for 5 months though, so it definitely lasts.

I was worried how this would look under my makeup but I was surprised that I can't tell a difference. I put it on last after my face serums and eye cream and it applies good. Smells nice and I love the dropper application.

I received this as a free sample and ended up throwing the sample in the trash after one use. The fragrance was very overwhelming. It did feel nice on my skin and it was very light but this made me skeptical about how effective the SPF is. I live in Flordia, so I take my daily SPF pretty seriously. I would rather use a more affordable sunscreen without fragrance.

I originally loved this formula, and I was super happy about it! I have no idea what happened on the first day differently because it felt amazing. On the second day, however, my skin turned red as a beet and I feel hot. I have no idea what ingredient is causing this because I don't have sensitive skin. It's a shame :(

I love this texture- it's super lightweight and doesn't feel greasy. It is scented, but that's a plus for me as I like the experience of putting on skincare a lot! It's also really easy to apply, which is super important as I forget to wear sunscreen when I'm not going outside. This is my new HG face sunscreen!
Definitely on the expensive side, but the product is smooth and smells nice. Not oily at all, which was nice. Wouldn't buy again, but that's just because I prefer moisturizers.
Love this face sunscreen, so light and nongreasy. Works great for protection.
keeps skin moist while protecting from burn, and doesn't clog pores or cause irritation..
This product is so light and applies really nicely and evenly. It's pricey but I find it lasts a while. The smell is so nice too, like salted ocean air.

I was in search of a sunscreen trying to enhance my skin care. I found this. Yes it's quite expensive. But I put it to the test being outside, in the sun, doing yard work (so I was sweating up a storm), it never came off. I usually have issues with sunscreen running into my eyes, and I have no problems with this one. No irritation to my sensitive skin either!
Doesn't work well for reapplication because of the very cute glitter. Start the day with this.

I discovered your products through a pilates instructor and saw the sunsilk drops. I also viewed the travel bag as a way to try your other sunscreen items. I love that they are organic, have benefits for my skin, cause no irritation, and are absorbed rapidly.
Works great and nice in light on my face. Best lotion I've bought for my face.

avis.titre: very strong smell, but well tolerated
avis.texte: Strong tangerine peel smell--not terrible but be aware if that's not for you. Dissipates quickly, though! Overall I like this product. A small amount goes a long way (I usually use a generous drop on each quadrant on my face and stretch all of that to my neck). Seems to be very moisturizing. I don't think it's made my hormonal breakouts worse, but YMMV--if you are sensitive to sunscreens breaking you out, I'd definitely remove before bed. I tend not to remove it and until I'm pms-ing, I don't break out any more than I normally would.
I like the light non greasiness of this coverage but not a fan of the eye dropper type applicator.

avis.titre: Def a new staple in my routine
avis.texte: Love these sun silk drops! It leaves a nice glow without feeling heavy and thick. I love the glow and it left my face and neck feeling moisturized. The bottle has lasted me forever and the application is super easy.

I've been searching for a daily sunscreen to wear under makeup and have relatively sensitive skin so I make an effort to only buy vegan and clean beauty products but this product instantly made my face start burning and swelling on my cheeks and under eyes. I quickly washed it off and the irritation went away after awhile but it was extremely uncomfortable and I'm very disappointed as I was originally going to buy a different sunscreen but decided on this one since it boasts its "clean" and great w makeup. Not worth the risk if you have any skin sensitivity.
Made me break out. I mistook 'œorganic' for being natural. Too many chemicals.

I'm not sure how well this protected against sunburn. I didn't like the oily consistency of this serum. I experienced an allergic reaction to this product. My face turned bright red immediately after application so I had to return it.

avis.titre: Love love love how this leaves my skin
avis.texte: One dropper full covers my entire face which provides me with protection but it also adds so much hydration to my skin. It is not a greasy formula. Only complaint would be the price but I'll definitely buy it again.
I like this over the supergoop. I'm new to using sunscreen but I love this product. I have oily skin and this product worked well. Definitely recommend

These Sun Silk Drops offer a really nice shine and good hydration. I absolutely love the packaging (dropper) and that a little bit of product goes a long way. The only thing I didn't like was that it has a bit of an oily feel to it. I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own.

I use this every day. I need to wear sunscreen wherever I go regardless of weather because I had stage III melanoma. I like the blue-screen protection too. The drops are light but moisturizing without oiliness.

*I received this product as a complimentary sample, but my opinions are my own.*I really enjoy using this product as a part of my everyday morning routine. It does feel a little bit greasy during application, but after a few minutes, it absorbs well into the skin and leaves my face feeling soft and smooth. It is lightweight, sheer, and provides excellent coverage. On top of sun protection, I feel that it gives my face a slightly dewy and youthful look -- my complexion seems to be a bit smoother with this product. I'm not sure how my skin would fare with this product in longer exposure to harsh sunlight, but I definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking for a casual, everyday sunscreen.

I have tried countless brands abd types of facial sunscreen but I always feel greasy and like my face is suffocating. This product is easy to apply and feels so lightweight that I don't even notice it throughout the day. I received the product as a complimentary sample, but my opinions are my own, and I am so glad to have found this!

I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own. I was able to use the Sun Silk Drops over a few days and I was quite impressed with them. The dripper was definitely something I had not used before in a sunscreen, but was impressed with how little I needed to use to moisture my face. I could feel the drops on my skin, but they were still lightweight and I would know if I needed to reapply if working hard outside. It also protects your skin against bluelight all while giving you a natural glow.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen serum I have ever used!!
avis.texte: This formula melts into my skin. No white cast. No oily face. I am so happy I found this product. I love it for every day after washing and moisturizing. Thank you Coola for this innovative product!!

Disclaimer **I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own. I have tried lots of different types of sunscreens but this has to be my favorite. I love the fact that it goes on easy and isn't greasy like a lot of other ones. It provides all day protection and is gentle enough for my whole family to use. I highly recommend it to anyone.
I have been using this sunscreen for about two years now. It is light and easy to apply.

Very lightweight and absorbs quickly giving my skin a healthy glow. It layers great under makeup and doesn't make me look greasy or anything, which is always a concern for me when layering SPF. I wore it on its own, mixed in with moisturizer or foundation, and it worked great for me. Love!

I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own. This product helps add moisture to the skin while protecting it. It felt good on my skin and it made me feel protected. I would recommend this product for every day use. I liked to wear it under my moisturizer and make up.

This silky drops is so amazing! Easy to apply and absorb quickly, provides a silky-smooth feel and cool touch on my face, makes my skin feel more replenished and nourished, more protected against the sun rays, won't make skin burns or cause redness, a very great product for summertime

These drops are so lightweight and only take moments to absorb into the skin. This is an SPF that doesn't feel like sunscreen and I love how it can be worn everyday. I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own.

avis.titre: Easy to apply, feels gentle on my skin
avis.texte: Product applies smoothly and feels light on my face. It's a tiny bit greasy, but it provides good coverage and still sits nicely under my makeup. I look forward to seeing how this sunscreen holds up in the summer time. I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own.

This goes on smooth and sinks in to my skin quickly for lightweight, invisible protection from the sun. This is a great alternative to more traditional sunscreens that can leave a white cast. (I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own.)
I received this product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own. These drops are amazing. They are light and soak in easily and make your skin feel amazing.
I received a free product and tried it for a week, it was amazing and the results are amazing. Thank you all.

I received the product complimentary to sample but my opinions are my own. I absolutely loved this product. My skin feels so much more refreshed and moisturized. It has a glow to it that I don't usually see until the summer. I will definitely go to the store to find more COOLA products. This was my first time trying COOLA products and I definitely do not regret giving these a try!
More chalk than cream. It won't rub in, feels like I am stretching my face to do it. Blocks pores. Really bummed out

Great product very light and very natural it was really amazing how great this feels non greasy very light and organic and after a few days I notice a difference already I will keep using if this product is this good and so far it seems real.

I LOVE this product. I have combination oily/dry skin and it's perfect. It gives my skin a dewy glow while being super lightweight and fast-absorbing. Obsessed with this, will for sure be a repeat purchase.

avis.titre: Like the product, not the dropper
avis.texte: This product is fine although a little runny and therefore more tricky to apply and blend with other cream type products. However, the dropper is inconvenient as it doesn't dispense enough product in one go. and is just cumbersome to use. A pump would be much more appropriate. Also, the plastic top is fragile. The first bottle I ordered arrived with the top broken. Coola replaced it in a very timely (major kudos for the consistently excellent customer service!).
I tried this product for a trip to Florida. I loved how it felt on my skin. It was lightweight and provided wonderful coverage . It really protected my face from the sun. With my hat of course

avis.titre: Works like a dream, HORRID fragrance
avis.texte: I really, really wish there was an unscented version of this product. First of all, I don't like using fragranced products on my face. Second, the fake citrusy fragrance makes me think of orange kool-aid. Not pleasant at all. I would rate it 5 stars in a heartbeat if it had no fragrance.
Just like the name says, it goes on like silk! Smooth and nice.
I love the silk drops to mix with your foundation or just to add to bare skin. The texture is very silky and nice and doesn't irritate my skin that is very sensitive.
I really wanted to love this product, but every time I used it the skin around my cheeks/eyes became red and puffy. Not sure what I reacted to, but be careful!

This product is amazing. I use prescription Retna A for anti-aging and search a long time for a mineral sunblock that would not leave a white film or add additional dryness to my skin. When I tried this product, I couldn't believe how good my skin looked and felt. The only way to describe this product it is absolutely amazing and one of the best sunblocks I've ever used. Coola products definitely are the best no matter what you are looking for, Coola gives you the best in skin care. Highly recommend Coola products for everyone.
I love this product. It goes on easy and blends in perfect with other serums.
Use every day under make-up, and it works like a charm. Love the applicator 😊

avis.titre: Works great for Acne and eczema prone skin
avis.texte: Love love love this sunscreen! I have acne and eczema prone sensitive skin and have been struggling to find the perfect spf. Others would break me out with pimples but this one did not! It's very light and won't clog my pores. I use my moisturizer first then apply the spf after. So happy I finally found a spf perfect for my skin

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life?
avis.texte: This isn't your typical sunscreen. It's incredibly moisturizing and has a soft, light milk texture that is sublime.
I use this every day mixed with my face lotion. It feels good using products that are good for you and protect your skin from sun damage.

I've been looking for a good sunscreen to wear under makeup that wouldn't pill, give me a white cast or feel crazy thick and I found it!! It's liquidy so it's easy to blend and smells amazing citrusy almost. Will definitely repurchase
Love using this under my makeup to make sure I'm getting the protection I need☺️
I personally have found this to be the easiest and lightest facial sunscreen for me to apply. It does not leave a white cast and has not caused a reaction on my sensitive skin.

I decided to try this because even in summer my skin can tend to be both oily and dry; but it still needs sun protection! And I hate a lot of mineral sunscreens do not wash off my face easily without me literally scrubbing my face beyond redness. Unfortunately this just clogged up my face especially the bridge of my nose and now I'm fighting to clear up my skin again.

avis.titre: Easy drops to add to your daily moisturizer
avis.texte: I absolutely love these silk drops, I've been using them for several years now. I mix it in with my normal moisturizer that does not have sunscreen and it gives me the daily protection I need. It does not make my skin greasy and I don't get breakouts. Excellent product!!
I used Silk Drops on a recent trip to Hawaii, it worked beautifully!! Coola is by far my favorite product!! It goes on so smooth and light, and I never burned! Thank you Coola!!

This morning the bottle was sitting on counter with lid resting closed while still in use. It got knocked over into sink and glass stem inside the cap shattered :( I had no idea it was thin glass would have been much more careful I guess. It will now be much harder to use if I finish and I'm hoping glass didn't get inside? Disappointed as its only half used.

A few weeks ago I gave some of these products a bad review. I was on a boat all day in Hawaii and only applied the sunscreen twice'"not enough. I have since used this product and used properly, it works really well. Really well.
I love this sunscreen, I am 57 yrs old, and it makes my skin feel so soft. It works great, and I wear it while fishing!

I first used this serum with SPF on a scuba trip to the Cayman islands. I was extra worried about sun protection due to the salt water and sun intensity. I wore these drops in addition to my regular SPF lotion and the effect was great! My skin felt soft and I didn't get sunburn. I recently purchased them to use as part of my summer skin routine.
